catalog.query.label: Query Photos
catalog.query.params: {filter?: Filter, sort?: Sort, offset?, limit?} — omit filter to list the current view

library.select.label: Select Photos
library.select.params: {ids: [id], active?: id, mode?: replace|add|toggle|range} — every id must be a photo of the library

develop.get.label: Get Develop Settings
develop.get.params: {id?} → the photo's develop settings; `process` is the rendering process they are interpreted by (see develop.updateProcess)

history.list.label: List History
history.list.params: {id?} — returns {history: labels oldest first, cursor: index of the step the settings are at (later steps can be returned to), versions}

develop.set.label: Set Develop Values
develop.set.params: {control?: controlId, value?: number, values?: {controlId: number}, ids?: [photo]} — see develop.controls; `crop.angle` turns the crop as crop.straighten does (kept if it still fits, else the largest of its aspect inside the photo)
